title.narrative: Emergency Food and Nutrition Response for Food-insecure Population in El Salam and Al Odeya Localities in West Kordofan State, Sudan.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project aims at reaching a total of 22,189 most vulnerable individuals among IDPs and host communities in Al Odiya and Al Salam localities, in West Kordofan to access life-saving FSL and nutrition services to improve household food security enhance their resilience, preparedness and self reliance. lt/pgtltpgtltugtUnder FSL sectorlt/ugt, the intervention proposes to provide emergency in-kind food assistance for vulnerable host and IDPs toltigt cover 6,071 individuals lt/igt(both host, IDPs HHs with adequate land to cultivate, and pastoralist communities). The intervention aims at responding cricitcal, life-saving food security needs to prevent famine like situation in the targeted geograpihc locaitons. lt/pgtltpgtltugtUnder Nutrition sectorlt/ugt support, lifesaving nutrition services will be provided in three static facilities (two nutrition OTPs, and one stabilization centers) , and via two mobile health teams to reach 1ltigt6,188 underserved populationlt/igt including dense settlements of newly displaced IDPs and hard to reach areas. Support will include treatment of SAM children with medical complications in Alodiya hospital, and without medical complication in 2 PHCCs and mobile teams. Active screening for acute malnutrition and referral to the supported health facilities (via support community volunteers) promotion of infant and young child feeding (IYCF through Mother Support Groups) practices for emergency contexts (IYCF-E) via one to one and group counselling and health education messaging and campaigns to the wider catchment population planned. Hygiene kits will also be provided to all SAM cases admitted in the OTPs to reduce water born disease related child illnesses. lt/pgtltpgtltspangtltugtThe national partner AORD lt/ugtwill be responsible for distributing 2,365 food rations from the total target of 6,706 individuals, in a harmonized manner with Concern Worldwide (modality, logistics and distribution). Under nutrition intervention the NNGO partner will cover lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtall community-based behavior change activities, including establishing and managing 8 MSGs (IYCF meetings), managing the community nutrition volunteers day-to-day work (awareness raising, community mobilization and house to house visits), and they will take care of the livestock in-kind distribution, and related logistics under the food security and livelihoods intervention. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThe project will mainstream cross-cutting programmatic approaches that include application of Accountability to Affected Populations principles, Do No Harm, conflict context analysis, gender equity as well as disability inclusion. ltbrgtlt/pgt
